title: Validate error message for exceeding maximum context length
description: This test case is designed to validate the error message when the maximum context length is exceeded
preconditions: A model is available for testing
The model's maximum context length is set to 8192 tokens
steps: Send a request to the model with a total of 11607 tokens (7607 in the messages, 4000 in the completion)

error.message: This model's maximum context length is 8192 tokens. However, you requested 11607 tokens (7607 in the messages, 4000 in the completion). Please reduce the length of the messages or completion.

assumptions: The system correctly handles and displays error messages
